reason: My clients' sender IDs are already approved with my current provider and it works, so a few cents cheaper per SMS isn't worth moving everything. And with 11.11 this close, I won't risk waiting on a new sender name approval mid-campaign.
objection: I don't know how fast the sender name gets approved or how reliable delivery is across networks. If messages land late or show up as a random number, the client blames me, not SMS Buddy.
would_change_my_mind: Agency features: one account managing several client sender IDs with separate credit, plus proof of delivery reports and a guaranteed sender ID approval time. Then I'd test it on one smaller client.
